svg.title: Checkout lifecycle
svg.desc: The checkout form opens with a cart (checkout.started). While the shopper fills it, user.created, user.updated, address.entered, address.updated, shipping.selected and payment.selected arrive in any order. A submit that fails its checks sends checkout.submitted with valid false and the shopper keeps filling. A submit that passes, or an express button, sends checkout.submitted with valid true and places the order, with the cart frozen. A refused order sends order.failed and goes back to filling. A created order (order.created) is either paid, which empties the cart, or awaits payment at its payment_complete_url (PayPal, 3-D Secure, …); once completed the paid order loads on the next page, and a payment that fails comes back to the checkout with the cart kept.
